summary: Very steep residential kerb, about 13% grade, beside flats and bush.
reasons: No Stopping signs on the stretch

drivers.seclusion: East kerb backs onto flats and bush; houses and flats stand within 25 m on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside room, but the grade makes it unusable.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with some through use.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9-5 signs; No Stopping Any Time signs at the corner.

flags: No Stopping signs on this stretch
sun_shade: Open, with street trees and shade from the building to the east.
